recipe.criteria: Lie prone holding a resistance band overhead. Keep arms long and torso steady; separate hands laterally into a small Y, pause, return with tension. Band remains attached to both closed grips and clear of the head. 3.5 seconds pull, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds return.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
